finding: Combinational logic detected before a synchronizer
baseline_same_rule_destination_clock: Combinational logic detected before a synchronizer
reviewed_findings.rationale: The newly selected launch clock comes from the board-clock reset guard. Destination is an existing vendor PCIe fundamental-reset consumer. Supported asynchronous assertion is preserved; the guard adds qualified delayed release, and the installed vendor reset logic remains intact. This must not be generalized into permission for arbitrary unsynchronized custom crossings. Actual routed effective link-up clear equals POR OR NOT qualified OR NOT released OR NOT link_status[0] OR NOT link_status[1]. The two XPM stages have CLR IS_INVERTED=1 and the complementary positive input truth; the output register has CLR IS_INVERTED=0 and the negative input truth. All 32 input combinations and these exact pin polarities are verified together. Two ASYNC_REG FDCE stages with vendor-defined INIT=1 followed by the FDCE output register with INIT=0, constant CE and direct D links, implement synchronous assertion of link-up after asynchronous deassertion, matching installed vendor HDL.

scope_limits: Recommendations cover the 36 actual routed new Critical/Warning records only; baseline still contains asynchronous CDC structures and is not a blanket clean-CDC signoff.
Final acceptance also requires bound reaudit report identity and all timing/DRC/route/HBM structural gates. No timing failure can be waived by this review.
The old A110 checkpoint was unavailable: correspondence uses archived exact CDC rows plus installed vendor HDL and current routed netlist, not a reopened old checkpoint.
External PCIe PERST/refclk contract remains required. The board 100 MHz guard does not prove PCIe refclk stability.
No hardware board test, analog metastability test, MTBF measurement, or complete end-to-end AXI/HBM transaction test is claimed.
Newer official manuals describe reset-interface semantics; installed Vivado 2020.2 HDL and actual routed primitives establish implementation-specific evidence.
